thread:
maya: Heads-up — ran into a conversion oddity from HF SPM -> Redwood BPE path. escape_char / sentinel tokens end up remapped to different ids, causing small but reproducible quality regression in our quant eval :confused:
sam: Can you paste the minimal repro? which model and which hf conversion toolchain?
maya: It's m-variant-spm-1, conversion pipeline: `tokenizers.SentencePieceBPETokenizer` -> export vocab -> our spm_to_bpe remapper script. Config.json lists `unk_token` and a nonstandard `sentencepiece_prefix` (weird).
olivia: Do you see specific token id shuffles or just extra tokens inserted?
maya: Specific shift. Example: `<extra_id_0>` maps to id 5020 pre-convert, post-convert it's 5023 and two other ids shift down. KV-cache alignments break during generation so eval BLEU/F1 drops ~0.5-1%.
jia: I saw something similar last month when the spm model had an escape_char byte (0x81) recorded in the SP config — huggingface's tokenizer adds a sentinel mapping entry at the end of vocab which our remapper didn't preserve. Impact on beam search scoring too.
andre: Could be the `merges` ordering — when you convert SPM pieces to BPE-like merges we sometimes dedupe or reorder pairs; that changes token id indices. Did you compare the `vocab` vs `merged` ordering produced by the HF exporter?
maya: Yup — quick diff shows 3 adjacent entries got re-ordered. I suspect our remap uses set() when building index (bad). Repro script attached in the thread (gist link).
ci-bot: test/conversion:conversion-smoke failed on 1978765432 — token-id-consistency — see logs.
sam: Ok next steps: 1) run the hf export then run a stable-index remapper (preserve original SPM index order), 2) add explicit special_tokens_map.json check, 3) add unit test comparing token->string roundtrip for first 20k ids.
olivea: tiny nit: watch out for `add_prefix_space` equivalents — SPM tokenization semantics differ around leading underscores. That can create off-by-one merges when you reconstruct pieces as BPE tokens.
jia: I'll take the unit tests and add a quant-eval baseline to catch regressions automatically. maya can you drop the minimal model + config into /tmp/repro-1978765432?
maya: Dropped it. Also included `spm.model`, `tokenizer_config.json`, and a small prompt list that triggers the regression. Thanks — will follow up with PR for remapper and test. :thumbsup:
